method: quantile-mapped from E5's thresholds (siglip2_base_384_rc4 Qdrant vectors) onto Scene Atlas-style ONNX embeddings of 400 px medium thumbnails; grouping/e5/calibrate.py
leaf_method: leaf_diff / leaf_same_prod / leaf_same: E6 change 2 (leaf default, positive different-map evidence) cohesion cuts, tuned on the dev small-import suite with the medium SA embeddings; quantile-mapped onto this encoder on the unit population of dev images (cosine of group-half means and of within-maker group means), t -> Q_this(F_medium(t)), as grouping/e5/calibrate.py; grouping/e6/calibrate_leaf.py.
leaf_source: E6, tuned on the medium SA embeddings; mapped to this encoder
scene_method: scene_agree_emb: E7 R5 scene agreement (edge map >= 0.50, a parameter, AND embedding cosine >= this), tuned on the E7 dev suites with the medium SA embeddings; quantile-mapped onto this encoder on a pair population of dev scenes (same-group pairs, same-folder pairs of different groups, random singleton pairs; identical draws for every encoder), t -> Q_this(F_medium(t)), as grouping/e6/calibrate_leaf.py; grouping/e7/calibrate_encoders.py.
scene_source: E7, tuned on the medium SA embeddings; mapped to this encoder
